 - The hippocampus may operate differently in older adults, not just weakening memory retention but altering how memories are recalled.

This event is linked to major disruptions in weather patterns, creating conditions for droughts in some regions while causing severe flooding and storm activity in others, underscoring the urgency for global preparedness and response efforts.

 - El Niño is projected to be the strongest event in over 70 years, with sea temperatures potentially reaching 4C above average.
 - Countries worldwide are implementing measures to mitigate impacts, including improved early warning systems and pre-emptive medical assistance.

 - Geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions are deepening the global refining crisis.
